A '''Customs Inspector''', '''Import Inspector''',<ref name="POC">{{WEGCite|story=The Politics of Contraband (adventure)|book=The Politics of Contraband}}</ref> or '''Security Inspector'''<ref name="AOB">{{WEGCite|story=The Art of Betrayal|book=The Politics of Contraband}}</ref> was a rank used by officials responsible for taxing imports. The rank was employed by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]]. [[Buudro]] held the rank of Customs Inspector.

Customs Inspectors were trained to find illegal and contraband items, and their skills were likened to that of [[Bloodhound/Legends|bloodhounds]]. However, not all Customs Inspectors were committed to their job, and could be bribed to look the other way. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[free-trader]]s found that one of their major operating expenses were paying bribes to inspectors.<ref name="RPG" />
